      From the manufacturer

      Redmi 8

      The Redmi 8 smartphone comes with a 6.22 inches ~81.8% screen-to-body ratio with Corning Gorilla Glass 5. This provides a clear and vibrant visual experience on your phone.

      Packed Camera for Better pictures

      The 12 MP, f/1.8, Dual Pixel PDAF 2 MP, depth sensor rear camera comes along with dual LED flash. It also comes with a 8 MP, f/2.0, front camera is useful for clicking beautiful moments which you can preserve with yourself. The phone also comes with a 64 GB internal storage and up to 512 GB (dedicated slot) of that you can use to store your media files and documents.

      Feature Rich Phone

      The Redmi 8 smartphone comes with a 5000 mAh battery for more standby time and if you run out of power you get 18w Fast charging . Call more, click more and play more with an extended battery life for your smartphone. Equipped with a Qualcomm SDM439 Snapdragon 439 ,Octa-core (2x1.95 GHz Cortex-A53 & 6x1.45 GHz Cortex A53),GPU Adreno 505 and 64GB 4GB RAM, the Redmi smartphone breathes more processing power when you are into visually intense games or shuffling between apps on your phone.
